counterfactual_missing_items: No documented improvement after anastrozole cessation
No explicit alternative uveitic/CME cause identified beyond normal blood tests and CT
decisive_items: had been on anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
cystoid macular edema with a yellow spot in the fovea in the right eye
Revealed cystoid macular edema with leakage in both right and left eyes
response.rationale: R5 uniquely links the anastrozole exposure to bilateral cystoid macular edema and FA leakage, which is the most specific and temporally coherent diagnosis. R2 captures the anterior chamber inflammation and iritis history but remains a broad descriptive finding and does not account for the drug exposure or the dominant CME/leakage pattern. R6 only explains the historical left-eye amblyopia and cannot explain the right-eye CME or bilateral leakage.

rejected.why: Amblyopia is a historical left-eye finding and cannot explain the right-eye CME, bilateral FA leakage, or anterior chamber inflammation.
